title: Fix MS_LLM_API_KEY vs MSA_LLM_API_KEY environment variable mismatch
description: MemorySmithConfigurationSetup maps MS_LLM_API_KEY env var to MemorySmith:Secrets:OpenAIApiKey, but OpenAICompatibleChatProvider.ResolveApiKey reads from MSA_LLM_API_KEY (via ChatOptions.OpenAIApiKeyEnvVar default). The key configured via the MS_ prefixed variable is never picked up by the provider. Align to a single consistent env var name (MSA_LLM_API_KEY) and remove the redundant configuration mapping. Source: codebase-audit-20260710-swarm-synthesis P1-001
